informal_statement:
If \(\lambda>1\) and \(-1<z<1\), the derivative value is
\[
D'(z)=z[1/\sqrt{1-z^2}-1/(\lambda\sqrt{\lambda^2-z^2})].
\]
reason: Source `CMVElementary.lean:204-209`: This is the derivative-value consequence of the preceding derivative theorem, with identical hypotheses and no endpoint extension.
